annotation.title_clean: ISO 21734-1:2022 Intelligent transport systems — Performance testing for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses in public transport — Part 1: General framework
annotation.title_en: ISO 21734-1:2022 Intelligent transport systems — Performance testing for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses in public transport — Part 1: General framework
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 21734-1:2022, an international standard from ISO/TC 204 setting a general framework and system components for operating automated driving buses in public transport networks, as a basis for performance testing of connectivity and safety functions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies general framework and operation scheme for public transport systems cooperating with automated driving buses
Defines system components for operating automated driving buses
Defines functions and requirements of each component for transport services
Applies to transport operators, public transport authorities and related industries
